mention: Mark Minervini (Trade Like a Stock Market Wizard, 2013; Think & Trade Like a Champion): a base in an uptrend where each pullback is shallower than the last (e.g. ~20% -> 10% -> 5%), volume dries up, price sits near its high, then breaks out.
